compiled_state.title: As a copy-story executor handling a multi-page epic, the coordination-pass smooths voice while protecting hard-constraint items
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: When the auto-created copy story detects distinct(page) > 1 in the Copy Needs section, append a coordination-pass task that re-dispatches gov-copy-writer in second-pass mode with the full first-pass rationale, while protecting hard-constraint items from mutation.
**Why**: sc-2 requires coordination-pass on multi-page epics; sc-5 requires hard-constraint items remain immutable; without this story, cross-page voice consistency is unmanaged or erodes legal/error copy.
**Scope**:
- IN: coordination-pass task attached by preplanning when distinct(page) > 1; second-pass dispatch receives full first-pass rationale; diff-check enforces immutability on items citing hard_constraint canon rules; updated artifact remains schema-conforming and re-runs the post-processor
- OUT: canon entry authoring (separate story); gov-copy-writer agent (separate story); post-processor (separate story)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, when the Copy Needs section contains items on 2 or more distinct page values, /dso:preplanning attaches a coordination-pass task to the copy story
  ← Satisfies: sc-2
- When this story is complete, with only 1 distinct page value, no coordination-pass task is attached
  ← Satisfies: sc-2
- When this story is complete, the coordination-pass dispatch receives the full first-pass rationale (rule_ids, conflicts, deviations) as input
  ← Satisfies: sc-5
- When this story is complete, items whose rationale.rule_ids cite a canon rule with hard_constraint=true have identical values pre- and post-coordination-pass; a diff check confirms zero mutations on those items
  ← Satisfies: sc-5
- When this story is complete, the updated artifact remains schema-conforming and re-runs the deterministic post-processor to refresh the checks block
  ← Satisfies: sc-3, sc-4
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations
- [Canon coupling] Canon entries must carry a hard_constraint flag so this story can detect them.
- [Race] The artifact path is shared with first-pass output; coordination-pass operates on a stable input snapshot.
- [Correctness] After coordination edits, re-running the post-processor will recompute checks{} for mutated items. Ensure rationale.deviations[].reason text on non-mutated items (especially hard-constraint items) survives the pass unchanged. Diff-check must reject any coordination output that drops a deviation reason from a hard-constraint item.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
